clauses.location: How to protect yourself / Keep out of the heat
clauses.quote: Avoid going outside and doing strenuous activity during the hottest time of day.
clauses.text_zh: 避免在一天中最热的时段外出或从事剧烈活动。
clauses.population: 一般公众；特殊人群需另行个体化建议

clauses.location: How to protect yourself / Keep out of the heat
How to protect yourself / Keep your body cool and hydrated
clauses.quote: Use light and loose-fitting clothing and bed linens.
Move person to a cooler environment, preferably a well air-conditioned room.
clauses.text_zh: 转移至较凉爽的环境，优先选择有适宜空调的房间。
clauses.population: 出现热相关不适者；需结合症状分流，不能据此确诊热衰竭

clauses.quote: Seek immediate medical attention if the person vomits, symptoms worsen or last longer than 1 hour
clauses.text_zh: 出现呕吐、症状加重或持续超过1小时时，立即寻求医疗帮助。
clauses.population: 热相关不适者；症状持续时间不得用户外暴露时长替代
